descriptions.w3d_file_owner_destroy: Releases file interfaces and destroys the file owner bases.
descriptions.w3d_file_owner_virtual_step: Dispatches the file owner virtual step.
descriptions.w3d_file_owner_apply_file: Selects a file-interface operation from the requested mode.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_owner_construct: Constructs the runtime owner and clears its service fields.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_owner_finish: Finishes the runtime owner and unregisters its context.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_replace_global_handle: Replaces the global service handle and clears a runtime flag.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_query_service_handle: Dispatches the runtime service handle query.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_prepare_services: Configures the runtime service, context and view.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_prepare_renderer: Initializes renderer output when the owner mode is zero.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_service_set_mode: Forwards the runtime service mode request.
